semantics.identity_rule: Each lease instance has an explicit identity.
semantics.expiry_rule: Expiry instant/duration and clock profile are explicit.
semantics.epoch_rule: Renewal/acquisition may advance explicit epoch/fencing token.
semantics.authority_rule: Lease possession is coordination evidence, not domain authorization.

invariants.rule: Definitions, requests, validation evidence, authorization decisions and concrete executions remain separate identities; only an explicit validated and authorized dispatcher path may create effects.

hard_gates.condition: lease expiry inferred from file mtime

lease id reused as resource id
